description: Amendments and alterations in the course of construction of Khalsa Primary School approved under Planning reference P/2007/3165, including: 1) the relocation of the stage/bay window structure from East elevation to South elevation of main hall; 2) Increase in height at first floor level (approx 1.7 metres) of part of entrance hall area linking the main hall and teaching block to provide a new small hall; 3) Provision of additional toilets to the second floor of the teaching block. Application P/2007/3165 previously approved on this site sought the removal of greenhouses, barn and portable buildings at west end of site, and the erection of part single, two and three-storey two-form entry Primary and Nursery School with associated facilities and hardstandings, including multi-use games area on playing field to north, formation of a pedestrian access and a vehicular access onto Norwood Green Road, alterations and formation of pedestrian and vehicular routes and provision of 57 car parking spaces, including 9 disabled parking spaces, for the proposed school and Norwood Hall, internal and external alterations and installation of wheelchair platform/stairlift access to north elevation, and an external staircase to Norwood Hall in conjunction with its use as an Adult Education and Community Centre (Please note that proposals do not include any changes to the approved Listed Building works at Norwood Hall)
